title: Cancel request
purpose: End a request that will not be fulfilled.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Managers and administrators, while the request is not final and none of its specimens is picked or shipped. A request with shipped material is closed instead. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept in the timeline and history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: The request becomes Cancelled (final). Its allocated specimens are released with their allocation holds, and its draft shipments are cancelled. The request and its history stay.
If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
